shows.title: Club NVRLND
shows.description:
Peter Pan is throwing London’s greatest night out at Club NVRLND - an irreverent, high-energy, immersive party where fairy dust is in the air, drinks flow, and the night is always young. Lose
yourself on the dancefloor in a nostalgia-fuelled adventure soundtracked by the biggest 2000s anthems from Britney, Rihanna, P!nk, Coldplay and more!

shows.title: An Evening With An Immigrant
shows.description: Award-winning poet and playwright Inua Ellams shares his extraordinary immigrant story, from leaving Nigeria for England at 12 to finding friendship, performing at the National Theatre, and drinking wine with the Queen, while searching for a place to call home.

shows.title: Rosie Jones: Anyone But Me (WIP)
shows.description: When an exciting offer of a radical new role comes across her desk - and the potential promise of awards glory - Rosie Jones has to figure out whether or not she is allowed to tell the story.

shows.title: Truth's a Dog Must to Kennel
shows.description: The Fool leaves King Lear before the blinding. Before the ice-creams in the interval. In this extraordinary solo work, Tim Crouch draws on ideas of virtual reality to send the character back to the wreckage of the world they left.
